name: Ven Client
description: Shows what is hidden: storage, spawners and ancient debris, X-ray, Fullbright, dug tunnels, and players and mobs through walls, with amethyst-based activity detection, Auto RTP and a free camera. Builds Litematica schematics as a player on foot would, finds a chunk for a base away from other players, and digs its room out. No trading bot.
